description: If every finite subset of \(T\) has a general model satisfying all of a fixed scheme \(C\), then \(T\cup C\) has a general model.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinSemantics.compactness_with_scheme.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  (T C : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinSemantics.Theory L)
  (h :
    ∀ (F : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinSemantics.Sentence L)),
      ↑F ⊆ T → Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinSemantics.Satisfiable (↑F ∪ C)) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinSemantics.Satisfiable (T ∪ C)
